blocks.en: Attachments A-E: Regulatory Requirements, CPGs, Extraction Studies, Abbreviations and References

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 熟悉 FD&C Act 中與包裝相關的法條 (Sections 501, 502, 505) 及其對應的 adulterated/misbranded 判定標準
blocks.en: Become familiar with the packaging-related provisions of the FD&C Act (Sections 501, 502, 505) and the corresponding adulterated/misbranded criteria

blocks.zh: 掌握 21 CFR 211 中與容器密封件相關的 CGMP 條文架構
blocks.en: Master the structure of the CGMP provisions of 21 CFR 211 relating to containers and closures

blocks.zh: 瞭解 CPSC child-resistant packaging 的法規要求與豁免情形
blocks.en: Understand the CPSC regulatory requirements for child-resistant packaging and the exemptions

blocks.zh: 理解 extraction study 的設計原理、溶劑選擇與分析方法
blocks.en: Understand the design principles, solvent selection and analytical methods of extraction studies

blocks.zh: 建立 USP General Chapters 與包裝測試方法的對應關係
blocks.en: Establish the correspondence between USP General Chapters and packaging test methods

blocks.zh: Attachment A: Regulatory Requirements 法規要求
blocks.en: Attachment A: Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94 四項核心要求:
blocks.en: The four core requirements of 21 CFR 211.94:

blocks.zh: (a) Non-reactive / Non-additive / Non-absorptive: 不改變 SISPQ
blocks.en: (a) Non-reactive / non-additive / non-absorptive: Does not alter SISPQ.

blocks.zh: (b) Adequate protection: 抵抗外部因素導致的劣化或污染
blocks.en: (b) Adequate protection: Resists deterioration or contamination from external factors.

blocks.zh: (c) Clean / Sterilized / Depyrogenated: 適合其預定用途
blocks.en: (c) Clean / sterilized / depyrogenated: Suitable for its intended use.

blocks.zh: (d) Written standards: 必須有書面的標準、接受標準和測試方法
blocks.en: (d) Written standards: There must be written standards, acceptance criteria and test methods.

blocks.zh: 這四點構成了 CGMP 對包裝材料管控的法規基礎，也是 FDA 查廠時的主要檢查項目。
blocks.en: These four points form the regulatory basis of CGMP control of packaging materials and are also the main focus of FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94 就像餐廳對餐具的四大要求：(a) 餐具不能與食物起化學反應（不沾鍋塗層不脫落）；(b) 餐具要能保護食物不被灰塵、蟲害污染（有蓋的容器）；(c) 餐具要乾淨、必要時消毒（高溫殺菌的餐具）；(d) 清洗和消毒程序要有書面 SOP。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.94 is like a restaurant's four requirements for tableware: (a) the tableware must not react chemically with the food (the non-stick coating must not flake off); (b) the tableware must protect the food from dust and pests (containers with lids); (c) the tableware must be clean and, where necessary, sanitized (heat-sterilized tableware); (d) the cleaning and sanitizing procedures must have a written SOP.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Indirect Food Additive Regulations (21 CFR 174-186) 的限制: 這些法規原本是針對食品包裝的，並不直接適用於藥品包裝。但 FDA 接受對固體口服劑型的包裝材料引用這些法規作為安全性證據。注意：對液體口服劑型（尤其是長期使用者）和注射劑，僅引用 food additive 法規通常不夠——需要額外的 extraction/toxicological evaluation。
blocks.en: Limitations of the Indirect Food Additive Regulations (21 CFR 174-186): These regulations were originally written for food packaging and do not apply directly to drug packaging. However, FDA accepts citing them as safety evidence for packaging materials of solid oral dosage forms. Note that for oral liquids (especially those used long-term) and injectables, citing only the food additive regulations is usually not enough; additional extraction/toxicological evaluation is needed.

blocks.zh: Child-resistant packaging 豁免: 機構內使用 (hospitals/nursing homes) 和 physician samples 可豁免。但出院帶藥處方仍需遵守 PPPA 要求。
blocks.en: Child-resistant packaging exemptions: Use within institutions (hospitals/nursing homes) and physician samples can be exempted. However, prescriptions dispensed to patients on discharge must still comply with the PPPA requirements.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: USP General Chapters 對照表: 此表是包裝測試方法的「路線圖」。對無菌 CDMO 最重要的章節：
blocks.en: USP General Chapters cross-reference table: This table is the "road map" of packaging test methods. The most important chapters for a sterile CDMO:

blocks.zh: USP <381>: elastomeric stopper 的生物和物化測試
blocks.en: USP <381>: Biological and physicochemical tests for elastomeric stoppers

blocks.zh: USP <87>/<88>: 塑膠和彈性體的生物反應性測試
blocks.en: USP <87>/<88>: Biological reactivity tests for plastics and elastomers

blocks.zh: USP <661>: 玻璃容器化學阻抗、塑膠物化測試、光透過率
blocks.en: USP <661>: Chemical resistance of glass containers, physicochemical tests for plastics, light transmission

blocks.zh: USP <71>: 無菌測試（驗證容器完整性）
blocks.en: USP <71>: Sterility test (to verify container integrity)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的品保部門應建立一份「法規對照清單」，將每個包裝組件對應到相關的 CFR 條文、USP 章節和測試方法。例如：注射劑 vial → 21 CFR 211.94 + USP <661> (Glass Containers) + USP <1> (Injections)；elastomeric stopper → USP <381> + USP <87>/<88>。這份清單是 FDA 查廠時展示法規遵從的最佳工具。
blocks.en: A CDMO's QA department should establish a "regulatory cross-reference list" that maps each packaging component to the relevant CFR provisions, USP chapters and test methods. For example: injectable vial → 21 CFR 211.94 + USP <661> (Glass Containers) + USP <1> (Injections); elastomeric stopper → USP <381> + USP <87>/<88>. This list is the best tool for demonstrating regulatory compliance during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94(a) 中的 "reactive, additive, or absorptive" 三個概念有何不同？請各舉一個無菌注射劑中的實際案例。
blocks.en: How do the three concepts "reactive, additive, or absorptive" in 21 CFR 211.94(a) differ? Give a real example of each in a sterile injectable.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 接受引用 indirect food additive regulations 作為固體口服劑型包裝材料的安全性證據，但對注射劑卻不行？
blocks.en: Why does FDA accept citing the indirect food additive regulations as safety evidence for packaging materials of solid oral dosage forms but not for injectables?

blocks.zh: Attachment B: Compliance Policy Guides (CPGs) 遵循政策指南
blocks.en: Attachment B: Compliance Policy Guides (CPGs)

blocks.zh: Compliance Policy Guides (CPGs): FDA 內部的執法指引，說明特定情況下的法規執行方式。雖然不是法規本身，但代表了 FDA 的執法態度。
blocks.en: Compliance Policy Guides (CPGs): FDA's internal enforcement guidance, explaining how regulations are enforced in specific situations. Although not regulations themselves, they represent FDA's enforcement stance.

blocks.zh: CPGs 就像交通警察的執法手冊——不是交通法本身，但告訴你什麼情況下會被開單。了解 CPGs 就是了解 FDA 的「執法紅線」在哪裡。
blocks.en: CPGs are like a traffic officer's enforcement manual: not the traffic law itself, but they tell you when you will be ticketed. Understanding the CPGs means understanding where FDA's "enforcement red lines" are.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 最相關的 CPGs：
blocks.en: The CPGs most relevant to a CDMO:

blocks.zh: CPG 7132a.06 (Sec. 410.100): Bulk container 中的成品——CGMP 如何適用
blocks.en: CPG 7132a.06 (Sec. 410.100): Finished product in bulk containers: how CGMP applies.

blocks.zh: CPG 7132b.11 (Sec. 480.200): Unit dose repackaging 的效期設定——repackager 的效期不能超過原包裝
blocks.en: CPG 7132b.11 (Sec. 480.200): Expiration dating for unit dose repackaging: the repackager's expiration date cannot exceed that of the original package.

blocks.zh: CPG 7132a.04 (Sec. 480.100): 效期和穩定性測試要求——與包裝驗證直接相關
blocks.en: CPG 7132a.04 (Sec. 480.100): Expiration dating and stability testing requirements: directly related to packaging validation.

blocks.zh: CPG 7132a.17 關於 tamper-resistant packaging 對 OTC 產品的要求，與 21 CFR 211.132 的關係是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between CPG 7132a.17 on tamper-resistant packaging requirements for OTC products and 21 CFR 211.132?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 接到客戶要求將產品從 multi-dose 重新包裝為 unit-dose，CPG 7132b.11 對效期設定有何限制？
blocks.en: If a CDMO receives a client request to repackage a product from multi-dose to unit-dose, what restrictions does CPG 7132b.11 place on expiration dating?

blocks.zh: Attachment C: Extraction Studies 萃取研究
blocks.en: Attachment C: Extraction Studies

blocks.zh: Extraction Study (萃取研究): 將包裝組件樣品（通常切碎以增加表面積）暴露在適當溶劑中，於升溫條件下進行萃取，然後分析萃取物。這是 Extractables & Leachables (E&L) 研究的核心實驗方法。
blocks.en: Extraction study: A sample of the packaging component (usually cut into pieces to increase surface area) is exposed to a suitable solvent and extracted at elevated temperature, and the extract is then analyzed. This is the core experimental method of Extractables & Leachables (E&L) studies.

blocks.zh: Extractables (可萃取物): 在加速條件（高溫、強溶劑）下從包裝組件中萃取出的化學物質——代表「最壞情況」下可能遷移到藥品中的所有物質。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemicals extracted from the packaging component under accelerated conditions (high temperature, strong solvents), representing everything that could migrate into the drug product under "worst-case" conditions.

blocks.zh: Leachables (浸出物): 在正常使用條件下實際遷移到藥品中的物質——是 extractables 的子集。
blocks.en: Leachables: Substances that actually migrate into the drug product under normal conditions of use; a subset of the extractables.

blocks.zh: Extraction study 就像用熱水泡茶——升溫加速萃取，就像用滾水泡茶比冷泡快得多。茶葉中所有能溶出的物質（extractables）就像用沸水強力萃取得到的一切；而日常飲用溫度下實際溶出的物質（leachables）是其中一小部分。FDA 要求先用「沸水」找出所有可能的溶出物，再評估正常條件下病人會接觸到多少。
blocks.en: An extraction study is like brewing tea with hot water: raising the temperature accelerates extraction, just as boiling water brews tea far faster than cold brewing. All the substances that can be dissolved out of the tea leaves (extractables) are like everything obtained by vigorous extraction with boiling water, while the substances that actually dissolve at everyday drinking temperature (leachables) are a small part of that. FDA requires first using "boiling water" to find all possible extractables, then assessing how much patients would be exposed to under normal conditions.

blocks.zh: 溶劑選擇邏輯（極為重要）：
blocks.en: Solvent selection logic (extremely important):

blocks.zh: Quantitative profile（定量）: 用藥品本身或 placebo vehicle 作為溶劑——最能反映實際浸出情況
blocks.en: Quantitative profile: Use the drug product itself or a placebo vehicle as the solvent; this best reflects actual leaching.

blocks.zh: Qualitative profile（定性）: 用比藥品更強的萃取溶劑——找出所有可能的 extractables，用於建立 QC 標準
blocks.en: Qualitative profile: Use an extraction solvent stronger than the drug product to find all possible extractables, for use in establishing QC criteria.

blocks.zh: 這個溶劑選擇邏輯直接影響 E&L 研究的設計，也是 FDA 審查的重點。
blocks.en: This solvent selection logic directly affects the design of E&L studies and is a focus of FDA review.

blocks.zh: Extraction study 不僅用於初始 qualification，也可作為常規 QC 手段來監控包裝組件的化學組成一致性。這對 elastomeric stoppers 尤其重要。
blocks.en: Extraction studies are used not only for initial qualification but also as a routine QC tool to monitor the consistency of the chemical composition of packaging components. This is especially important for elastomeric stoppers.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
Extraction Study 五大目的：
1. USP <661> plastics 特性測試
2. USP <381> elastomers 特性測試
3. USP <87>/<88> 生物反應性測試
4. Qualitative extraction profile → QC criteria
5. Quantitative extraction profile → Safety evaluation
blocks.en:
The five main purposes of an extraction study:
1. USP <661> plastics characterization tests
2. USP <381> elastomers characterization tests
3. USP <87>/<88> biological reactivity tests
4. Qualitative extraction profile → QC criteria
5. Quantitative extraction profile → Safety evaluation

blocks.zh: CDMO 在驗證新的包裝組件時，extraction study 的設計應考慮：(1) 產品為水性還是含共溶劑（如 polysorbate 80、乙醇），因為共溶劑會增強萃取能力；(2) 樣品的表面積/體積比要模擬實際使用條件；(3) 升溫條件要合理加速但不能改變材料的化學性質。建議同時進行定性（強溶劑）和定量（藥品 vehicle）兩套研究。結果可與 PQRI 的 Safety Concern Threshold (SCT) 和 Qualification Threshold (QT) 比對以評估安全性。
blocks.en: When qualifying a new packaging component, a CDMO should consider the following in designing the extraction study: (1) whether the product is aqueous or contains cosolvents (such as polysorbate 80 or ethanol), since cosolvents enhance extraction capacity; (2) the sample surface area/volume ratio should simulate actual conditions of use; (3) the elevated temperature should accelerate extraction reasonably without altering the chemical nature of the material. Running both a qualitative study (strong solvent) and a quantitative study (drug product vehicle) is recommended. The results can be compared against the PQRI Safety Concern Threshold (SCT) and Qualification Threshold (QT) to assess safety.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 建議定性 extraction profile 使用比藥品更強的溶劑，而定量 profile 使用藥品本身？這兩種資訊各自的用途是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does FDA recommend using a solvent stronger than the drug product for the qualitative extraction profile, but the drug product itself for the quantitative profile? What is each type of information used for?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶的注射劑含有 10% polysorbate 80，您預期 extraction study 的結果會比純水萃取高還是低？這對包裝材料選擇有何影響？
blocks.en: If a client's injectable contains 10% polysorbate 80, would you expect the extraction study results to be higher or lower than with water extraction? How does this affect the choice of packaging material?

blocks.zh: Elastomeric stopper 的 routine extraction monitoring 應多久進行一次？批次變更時是否需要重做？
blocks.en: How often should routine extraction monitoring of an elastomeric stopper be performed? Does it need to be repeated when the batch changes?

blocks.zh: Attachment D: Abbreviations 縮寫對照
blocks.en: Attachment D: Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 本表提供指引中所有縮寫的完整對照。對 CDMO 從業人員而言，最常用的縮寫包括：
blocks.en: This table gives the full cross-reference of all abbreviations in the guidance. For CDMO practitioners, the most commonly used abbreviations include:

blocks.zh: SVP/LVP: 小量/大量注射劑，以 100 mL 為分界
blocks.en: SVP/LVP: Small-volume/large-volume parenterals, divided at 100 mL.

blocks.zh: HDPE/LDPE: 高密度/低密度聚乙烯，密度影響阻隔性能
blocks.en: HDPE/LDPE: High-density/low-density polyethylene; density affects barrier performance.

blocks.zh: DMF/LOA: 藥品主檔案/授權信，包裝材料資訊管理的核心機制
blocks.en: DMF/LOA: Drug Master File/Letter of Authorization, the core mechanism for managing packaging material information.

blocks.zh: COA: 分析證書，包裝材料接收的基本文件
blocks.en: COA: Certificate of Analysis, a basic document for receipt of packaging materials.

blocks.zh: 這份縮寫表就像航空業的代碼手冊——每個三字母代碼背後都有精確的定義。在 GMP 文件中，使用標準化縮寫確保全球溝通的一致性和精確性。
blocks.en: This abbreviation table is like an airline code handbook: behind every three-letter code is a precise definition. In GMP documents, using standardized abbreviations ensures consistency and precision of communication worldwide.

blocks.zh: 注意 FDA 內部有多個中心 (Centers) 共同管轄包裝：CDER（化學藥品）、CBER（生物製品）和 CFSAN（食品安全——indirect food additive 由此中心管轄）。瞭解哪個中心負責什麼，有助於在送審策略上做出正確判斷。
blocks.en: Note that several FDA Centers share jurisdiction over packaging: CDER (chemical drugs), CBER (biologics) and CFSAN (food safety, which has jurisdiction over indirect food additives). Understanding which center is responsible for what helps in making the right judgment on submission strategy.

blocks.zh: SVP 和 LVP 的分界為何設在 100 mL？這對包裝材料選擇和測試要求有何差異？
blocks.en: Why is the boundary between SVP and LVP set at 100 mL? How does this affect packaging material selection and testing requirements?

blocks.zh: HDPE 和 LDPE 在藥品包裝中的典型應用各是什麼？為什麼密度差異會影響阻隔性能？
blocks.en: What are the typical applications of HDPE and LDPE in drug packaging? Why does the difference in density affect barrier performance?

blocks.zh: Attachment E: References 參考文獻
blocks.en: Attachment E: References

blocks.zh: 本參考文獻清單反映了 1999 年時 FDA 的 CMC guidance 體系。對無菌 CDMO 最相關的是：
blocks.en: This reference list reflects FDA's CMC guidance framework as of 1999. The most relevant for a sterile CDMO are:

blocks.zh: Sterilization Process Validation (1994): 包裝組件的滅菌和去熱原製程驗證
blocks.en: Sterilization Process Validation (1994): Validation of sterilization and depyrogenation processes for packaging components.

blocks.zh: Drug Master Files (1989): Type III DMF 的格式和內容指引
blocks.en: Drug Master Files (1989): Guidance on the format and content of Type III DMFs.

blocks.zh: Photostability Testing (1997): 包裝對光保護功能的測試參考
blocks.en: Photostability Testing (1997): A reference for testing the light protection function of packaging.

blocks.zh: 這份參考文獻清單就像一本書的延伸閱讀書單——每份引用的指引都針對特定產品類型（mAb、疫苗、血液製品等）提供更詳細的 CMC 送審要求。Container Closure Systems 指引是「通用教科書」，而這些引用文件是「各科專業教材」。
blocks.en: This reference list is like the further reading list of a book: each cited guidance gives more detailed CMC submission requirements for a specific product type (mAbs, vaccines, blood products and so on). The Container Closure Systems guidance is the "general textbook", and these cited documents are the "specialist texts for each subject".

blocks.zh: 雖然許多引用的指引已被後續版本更新或取代（例如穩定性指引已更新為 ICH Q1A-Q1F 體系），但本 1999 年 Container Closure Systems guidance 本身至今仍為有效文件，尚未被新版取代。這使得本文件在 FDA 包裝送審體系中具有持續性的重要地位。
blocks.en: Although many of the cited guidances have been updated or replaced by later versions (for example, the stability guidance has been updated to the ICH Q1A-Q1F series), this 1999 Container Closure Systems guidance itself remains a valid document to this day and has not been replaced by a new version. This gives the document a continuing importance in the FDA packaging submission framework.

blocks.zh: 注意多份 CMC guidance 涵蓋 biologics 產品（mAb、vaccines、blood products、cell therapy）——每一種都有其獨特的包裝考量，尤其是蛋白質藥物對容器表面吸附和 extractables 的敏感性。
blocks.en: Note that several CMC guidances cover biologics products (mAbs, vaccines, blood products, cell therapy), each with its own packaging considerations, especially the sensitivity of protein drugs to container surface adsorption and extractables.

blocks.zh: 本指引發布於 1999 年，至今已超過 25 年。哪些包裝技術的發展（如 ready-to-use components、cyclic olefin copolymer 容器）使得本指引的某些內容可能需要更新？
blocks.en: This guidance was issued in 1999, more than 25 years ago. Which developments in packaging technology (such as ready-to-use components and cyclic olefin copolymer containers) mean that parts of this guidance may need updating?

blocks.zh: 對於 mAb 注射劑產品，除了本指引外，還應參考哪些 FDA/ICH 指引來完整涵蓋 CCS 的 CMC 送審要求？
blocks.en: For an mAb injectable product, which other FDA/ICH guidances should be consulted besides this guidance to fully cover the CMC submission requirements for the CCS?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: FD&C Act Sections 501/502/505 提供包裝法規的法律基礎——adulterated (有毒容器)、misbranded (包裝遺漏)、NDA 要求 (全面描述)
blocks.en: FD&C Act Sections 501/502/505 provide the legal basis for packaging regulation: adulterated (toxic container), misbranded (packaging omissions), NDA requirements (full description).

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94 是 CGMP 對包裝管控的核心條文：non-reactive / non-additive / non-absorptive + adequate protection + clean/sterilized + written standards
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.94 is the core CGMP provision for packaging control: non-reactive / non-additive / non-absorptive + adequate protection + clean/sterilized + written standards.

blocks.zh: CPSC 16 CFR 1700 管轄 child-resistant packaging，有特定豁免情形（機構使用、physician samples 等）
blocks.en: CPSC 16 CFR 1700 governs child-resistant packaging, with specific exemptions (institutional use, physician samples and so on).

blocks.zh: Indirect food additive regulations (21 CFR 174-186) 可用於固體口服劑型的安全性佐證，但注射劑和長期使用的液體口服劑型需要額外的 E&L 數據
blocks.en: The indirect food additive regulations (21 CFR 174-186) can be used as supporting safety evidence for solid oral dosage forms, but injectables and long-term liquid oral dosage forms need additional E&L data.

blocks.zh: Extraction study 設計的核心：溶劑選擇取決於目的——定量用藥品/placebo，定性用更強溶劑；升溫加速萃取但須合理
blocks.en: The core of extraction study design: solvent selection depends on the purpose; use the drug product/placebo for quantitative and a stronger solvent for qualitative; elevated temperature accelerates extraction but must be reasonable.

blocks.zh: USP General Chapters 構成包裝測試方法的標準體系，其中 <381>、<661>、<87>/<88> 對無菌產品最為關鍵
blocks.en: USP General Chapters form the standard system of packaging test methods, of which <381>, <661> and <87>/<88> are the most critical for sterile products.
